AMENDMENT OF PARAGRAPH 2 AND PARAGRAPH 3 OF THE MINUTE ON THE SRI LANKA AUDIT
SERVICE

PARAGRAPH 2 and paragraph 3 of the Minute on the Sri Lanka Audit Service published in the Gazette Extraordinary,No. 588/5 dated 11th December 1989 and amended by the Gazette Extraordinary No. 993/17 dated 19th September 1997 andNo. 1656/23 dated 04th December 1998 have been amended by the Public Service Commission and the amended paragraphsare published for information.
These amendment will be effective from the date of publication in the Gazette.
W. P. C. WICKRAMARATNE,
Acting Auditor General.Auditor General’s Department,Battaramulla,04th March, 2015.
Amendment of paragraph 2 and paragraph 3 of the Minute on the Sri Lanka Audit Service

The paragraph 2 and paragraph 3 of the Minute on the Sri Lanka Audit Service published in the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 588/5 dated 11th December 1989 and amended by the Gazette Extraordinary No. 993/17 dated 19th September 1997 andNo. 1056/23 dated 04th December 1998 have been amended by the Public Service Commission and the amended paragraph arepublished for information.

Insertion of new paragraph 3(I) above the existing paragraph 3(I)
3(I) Promotion of the Deputy Auditors General in Class 1 Grade 1 of the Sri Lanka Audit Service to the Special Grade.
(a) Qualifications to be fulfilled

The promotion of the officers in Class 1 Grade 1 of the service who have fulfilled the following requirements to thevacancies in the Special Grade of the Service will be made only through promotion by the Public Service Commission.
(i) Has obtained a Postgraduate Degree in Accounts or Auditing (a field of study or as a subject) from a University/

Institute recognized by the University Grant Commission or has obtained the full membership of the Institute ofChartered Accountants of Sri Lanka or the Institute of Chartered Accountants of England and Wales or thechartered Institute of Management Accountants of the United Kingdom or the Institute of Certified CharteredAccountants of the United Kingdom.
(ii) Has completed an active and satisfactory service period of five (05) years in Class I Grade I of the Sri Lanka
Audit Service by the date of becoming eligible and earned five (05) salary increment after the promotion toClass 1.
(iii) Has completed an active and satisfactory service period of not less than 18 years in the Executive Grade in the
qualifying Sri Lanka Audit Service by the date of becoming eligible.
(This paragraph is not applicable to the direct recruits to Class I of the Sri Lanka Audit Service.)
(iv) Should have had a satisfactory or a higher level of performance for a period of five (05) years immediately
preceding the date of becoming eligible for promotion.
(v) Should have had a satisfactory service period of five (05) years in Class 1 and not being subjected to a
disciplinary punishment by the date of becoming eligible for promotion.
(b) Method of Promotion

The Promotion of the Deputy Auditor’s General of Class 1 Grade 1 of in Sri Lanka Audit Service to the Special Gradeonly by promotion will be made by in Public Service Commission. The officers who fulfill all the qualifications statedabove will be promoted to the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Audit Service according to the vacancies and onseniority.
(c) Appointment to the posts of Additional Auditors General
Insertion of —

“The senior most officers who have served as Deputy Auditors General out of the officers in the Special Grade of theSri Lanka Audit Service will be appointed to the posts of Additional Auditor General according to the existingvacancies by the Public Service Commission on the recommendation of a Board of Interview appointed by thePublic Service Commission.
As a new paragraph 3(I) has been added the existing paragraphs 3(I), (II) and (III) are amended as 3(II), (III) and (IV)respectively.
W. P. C. WICKRAMARATNE,
